text.Kredinin Gerçek Maliyeti: Faiz, KKDF, BS: The True Cost of a Loan: Interest, KKDF, BSMV and Fees - KredimGeldi
text.Aylık faiz oranı kredinin maliyetini tek: The monthly interest rate alone doesn't show what a loan really costs. We explain KKDF, BSMV, processing fees and the annual cost rate with a worked example.
text.Kredi tekliflerini karşılaştırırken çoğu: When comparing loan offers, most of us look at the monthly interest rate first. Yet the real difference between two offers is often hidden in the taxes added to the interest, the processing fee and the term. In this article, we explain each item that makes up the total cost of a loan one by one and work out the result together with an example calculation.
text.Akdi faiz: Hesabın başlangıç noktası: Contractual interest: Where the calculation starts
text.Faiz oranındaki küçük farklar uzun vaded: Small differences in the interest rate add up over a long term. A difference of just 0.10 percentage points per month can noticeably change the total repayment on a 36-month personal loan. That's why offers should be compared using the same amount and the same term.
text.KKDF ve BSMV: Faize eklenen vergiler: KKDF and BSMV: Taxes added to interest
text.Bireysel kredilerde faize iki ayrı yük e: Two separate charges are added to the interest on consumer loans:
text.Bunun dışında kredi türüne göre eksperti: Depending on the loan type, there may also be a property appraisal fee, a mortgage registration fee or insurance premiums. Some banks offer products such as life insurance as a condition of a campaign; when getting an offer, always ask whether the insurance is mandatory and how much the premium is.
text.Hesabı somutlaştıralım. Aylık %3,00 akdi: Let's make this concrete. Suppose you take out a 100,000 TL personal loan with a 12-month term at a contractual interest rate of 3.00% per month.
text.Vergiler olmasaydı taksit 10.046,21 TL o: Without the taxes, the installment would be 10,046.21 TL. In this example, KKDF and BSMV add roughly 6,567 TL in extra cost in total.
text.İlk taksitteki dağılıma bakmak da faydal: It's also worth looking at how the first installment breaks down: one month's interest on 100,000 TL is 3,000 TL. On top of that come 450 TL of KKDF and 450 TL of BSMV. The rest of the installment reduces the principal.
text.Vade uzadıkça maliyet nasıl değişir?: How does the cost change as the term gets longer?
text.Uzun vade aylık taksidi düşürür ama topl: A longer term lowers the monthly installment but increases the total you pay. For the same 100,000 TL loan at an after-tax monthly rate of 3.90%, the approximate figures are:
text.36 ay vadede aylık taksit 12 aya göre ya: With a 36-month term, the monthly installment drops by almost half compared with 12 months, while the total repayment rises by more than 60,000 TL. The right term is the shortest one that doesn't strain your budget.
text.Yıllık maliyet oranı neden önemli?: Why does the annual cost rate matter?
text.Teklifleri her zaman aynı tutar ve aynı: Always compare offers using the same amount and the same term. An offer with a low interest rate but high fees can end up costing more overall.
text.Faiz, KKDF, BSMV ve dosya masrafı dahil: Compare installments across banks, including interest, KKDF, BSMV and the processing fee.
text.Konut kredisinde KKDF ve BSMV ödenir mi?: Are KKDF and BSMV charged on home loans?
text.Hayır. Bireysel konut kredileri KKDF ve: No. Consumer home loans are exempt from KKDF and BSMV. That's why the advertised interest rate on a home loan is used directly to calculate the installment.
text.Dosya masrafı en fazla ne kadar olabilir: What is the maximum processing fee?
text.Bireysel kredilerde kredi tahsis ücreti,: On consumer loans, the loan allocation fee cannot exceed 0.5% (5 per thousand) of the loan amount disbursed.
text.Aylık faiz mi, yıllık maliyet oranı mı d: Which matters more: the monthly interest rate or the annual cost rate?
text.Karşılaştırma için yıllık maliyet oranı: The annual cost rate is the more accurate measure for comparison, because it includes taxes and fees as well as interest.

html.Bankanın ilan ettiği aylık oran <strong>: The monthly rate advertised by the bank is called the contractual interest. With equal-installment loans, part of each monthly installment goes toward interest and the rest toward the principal. In the first months, the outstanding principal is high, so most of the installment is interest; as the term progresses, the principal share grows.
html.<strong>KKDF (Kaynak Kullanımını Destekl: KKDF (Resource Utilization Support Fund): Charged at 15% of the interest amount on personal and vehicle loans.
html.<strong>BSMV (Banka ve Sigorta Muamelele: BSMV (Banking and Insurance Transaction Tax): Also applied at 15% of the interest amount on these loans.
html.Bu iki vergi anaparaya değil, <strong>he: These two taxes are added not to the principal but to the interest amount in each installment. So on a personal loan at 3.00% monthly interest, the effective monthly rate is 3.00 × 1.30 = 3.90%. Consumer home loans, on the other hand, are exempt from KKDF and BSMV; the advertised interest on a home loan is used directly to calculate the installment.
html.Bankalar kredi kullandırırken <strong>kr: When disbursing a loan, banks may charge a loan allocation fee (commonly known as the processing fee). On consumer loans, this fee cannot exceed 0.5% (5 per thousand) of the loan amount. For a 100,000 TL loan, that means a maximum of 500 TL.
html.Bankalar, sözleşme öncesinde size bir bi: Before you sign the contract, banks are required to give you an information form. The annual cost rate on this form reflects interest, taxes and items such as the allocation fee together. Looking at this rate is the fairest way to compare offers with different interest and fee structures.
